records.synonym_note: POWO recognizes Bermudiana angustifolia and Sisyrinchium bermudiana subsp. angustifolium as homotypic synonyms; some historical Bermudiana names are not validly published or later homonyms. Keep Sisyrinchium bermudiana independently accepted; do not merge unrelated concepts.
records.concept_caution: Historical Bermudiana and bermudiana-rank usage requires author-sensitive crosswalk; no specimen identification inferred.

records.synonym_note: Direct POWO species page accepts S. biforme and lists no synonyms. POWO genus list independently accepts S. dimorphum R.L.Oliv.; earlier ITIS-based tracker text calls S. dimorphum a synonym of S. biforme. Preserve this authority disagreement, do not automatically collapse S. dimorphum.
records.concept_caution: Corrects earlier genus-only source URL: 329986-2 is the genus, while 440959-1 is the direct S. biforme species record.

records.synonym_note: POWO treats Sisyrinchium amoenum and S. colubriferum as heterotypic synonyms of S. ensigerum. POWO cites an alternative New Mexico flora treatment under S. chilense; retain accepted POWO name and note alternate concept.
records.concept_caution: Alternative treatment as S. chilense is not a license to merge the independently accepted S. chilense concept or re-identify photos.

records.synonym_note: POWO lists S. canbyi, S. flaccidum, S. furcatum, S. implicatum and illegitimate later homonym S. tenuifolium Raf. as heterotypic synonyms. This author-qualified historical homonym is not S. tenuifolium Humb. & Bonpl. ex Willd., which POWO separately accepts.
records.concept_caution: Historical homonym caution only; source name accepted without a species-rank mapping change.
